CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._org_admin_org()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT p.organization_id FROM public.profiles p
   WHERE p.user_id = auth.uid() AND p.organization_id IS NOT NULL
     AND public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
     AND NOT public.is_platform_superadmin(auth.uid())
   LIMIT 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.h15_actor_organization()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT platform_private.h15_actor_organization(); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_role(_user_id uuid, _role app_role)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT platform_private.has_role(_user_id,_role); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_platform_superadmin(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r
    WHERE r.user_id = _user_id AND r.role = 'superadmin'::public.app_role
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.org_status_transition_ok(_de text, _para text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT (_de, _para) IN (
    ('rascunho','aguardando_ativacao'),('rascunho','cancelada'),
    ('aguardando_ativacao','onboarding'),('aguardando_ativacao','rascunho'),('aguardando_ativacao','cancelada'),
    ('onboarding','ativa'),('onboarding','cancelada'),('onboarding','suspensa'),
    ('ativa','suspensa'),('ativa','cancelada'),
    ('suspensa','ativa'),('suspensa','cancelada'))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_set_organization_status(_org uuid, _status text, _motivo text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT public.is_platform_superadmin(auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'platform_forbidden: apenas superadmin' USING errcode='42501'; END IF;
  IF _motivo IS NULL OR length(btrim(_motivo)) < 5 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'platform_invalid: motivo obrigatório'; END IF;
  IF _status = 'ativa' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.organizations WHERE id=_org AND status='onboarding') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'platform_invalid: ativação ocorre ao concluir onboarding'; END IF;
  PERFORM public._org_set_status(_org, _status, btrim(_motivo));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_fiscal_company_rtc_get()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_row public.company_fiscal_settings%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.h15_require_staff();

  IF NOT public._fiscal_rtc_can_read(v_uid) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_row FROM (SELECT * FROM public.company_fiscal_settings WHERE organization_id = public.h15_actor_organization()) company_fiscal_settings
   ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'configuration', COALESCE(v_row.rtc_configuration,'{}'::jsonb),
    'revision', COALESCE(v_row.updated_at::text,''),
    'exists', v_row.id IS NOT NULL);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_fiscal_sefaz_transmission_status_v1(_invoice_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_items jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.h15_require_staff();
  IF _invoice_id IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM public.h15_require_invoice(_invoice_id); END IF;

  IF NOT public.fn_fiscal_can_read_internal(auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_FORBIDDEN';
  END IF;

  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x->>'createdAt' DESC), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_items
  FROM (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'transmissionId', t.id, 'service', t.service, 'state', t.state,
      'outcome', t.outcome,
      'invoiceId', t.fiscal_invoice_id, 'xmlRunId', t.xml_run_id,
      'eventId', t.fiscal_event_id,
      'environmentCode', t.environment_code, 'endpointHost', t.endpoint_host,
      'cStat', t.c_stat, 'xMotivo', t.x_motivo, 'chNFe', t.ch_nfe,
      'nProt', t.n_prot, 'nRec', t.n_rec, 'dhRecbto', t.dh_recbto,
      'errorCode', t.error_code, 'attempt', t.attempt,
      'correlationId', t.correlation_id,
      'createdAt', t.created_at, 'completedAt', t.completed_at) AS x
    FROM (SELECT * FROM public.fiscal_sefaz_transmissions WHERE public.h15_invoice_access(fiscal_invoice_id)) t
    WHERE (_invoice_id IS NULL OR t.fiscal_invoice_id = _invoice_id)
    ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 50
  ) s;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ceiling', 'HOMOLOGATION', 'environmentCode', '2',
                            'items', v_items);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_fiscal_xml_status_v1(p_invoice_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_runs jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.h15_require_staff();
  PERFORM public.h15_require_invoice(p_invoice_id);

  IF NOT public.fn_fiscal_can_read_internal(auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_FORBIDDEN: perfil sem permissao para consultar execucoes de XML.';
  END IF;

  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
           'runId', r.id, 'runVersion', r.run_version, 'state', r.state,
           'engineVersion', r.engine_version, 'schemaVersion', r.schema_version,
           'accessKey', r.access_key, 'environmentCode', r.environment_code,
           'payloadSha256', r.payload_sha256,
           'unsignedSha256', r.unsigned_sha256, 'unsignedBytes', r.unsigned_bytes,
           'signedSha256', r.signed_sha256, 'signedBytes', r.signed_bytes,
           'hasUnsigned', r.unsigned_path IS NOT NULL,
           'hasSigned', r.signed_path IS NOT NULL,
           'validation', r.validation, 'signature', r.signature_metadata,
           'errorCode', r.error_code,
           'preparedAt', r.prepared_at, 'generatedAt', r.generated_at,
           'validatedAt', r.validated_at, 'signedAt', r.signed_at, 'failedAt', r.failed_at)
           ORDER BY r.run_version DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_runs
    FROM (SELECT * FROM public.fiscal_xml_runs WHERE public.h15_invoice_access(fiscal_invoice_id)) r
   WHERE r.fiscal_invoice_id = p_invoice_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('invoiceId', p_invoice_id, 'ceiling','SIGNED', 'runs', v_runs);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.cnpj_normalizar(_v text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT nullif(upper(regexp_replace(coalesce(_v,''), '[\s./-]', '', 'g')), '')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.h15_actor_organization()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT p.organization_id FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id AND o.ativo IS TRUE WHERE p.user_id=auth.uid() AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p.user_id);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.has_role(_user_id uuid, _role app_role)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r JOIN public.profiles p ON p.user_id=r.user_id WHERE r.user_id=_user_id AND r.role=_role AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p.user_id));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.issue_ticket(_scope text, _target uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  INSERT INTO platform_private.authz_tickets(txid, scope, target)
  VALUES (txid_current(), _scope, _target) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.stock_envase_mutation_gate_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET lock_timeout TO '3s'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_LEVEL<>'STATEMENT' OR TG_WHEN<>'BEFORE' OR TG_OP NOT IN ('INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE','TRUNCATE')
 OR TG_RELID NOT IN ('public.organizations'::regclass,'public.organization_subscriptions'::regclass,'public.saas_plan_versions'::regclass,'public.saas_plan_version_features'::regclass,'public.saas_features'::regclass,'public.saas_modules'::regclass,'public.organization_feature_overrides'::regclass,'public.clientes'::regclass,'public.programacao_producao'::regclass,'public.ordens_servico'::regclass,'public.lotes'::regclass,'public.controle_qualidade'::regclass,'public.estoque_produto'::regclass) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ENVASE_GATE_CONTEXT_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 -- Existing upstream RPCs can prelock business rows before their first DML.
 -- Never wait here while owning those rows: reject contention atomically instead
 -- of closing the singleton/business-row deadlock cycle.
 PERFORM 1 FROM cf_user_guards_v1.state WHERE singleton FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'STOCK_GATE_UNAVAILABLE' USING ERRCODE='PT503'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$
